title: Vibrant Charred Greek Spinach Spanakopita
description: A charred, snappy, quick-fix Greek dish featuring unsalted pistachio and tempering chocolate, this spanakopita is a FODMAP-friendly delight. It combines the freshness of spinach with the crunch of pistachios.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Chop the fresh spinach and set it aside in a bowl.
Mix the chopped spinach with crumbly feta cheese, chopped unsalted pistachio, and a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Layer the filo dough sheets on a flat surface, brushing each sheet with olive oil.
Place one quarter of the spinach mixture onto one end of the filo dough, leaving a small border around the edges.
Fold the filo dough over the spinach mixture to form a triangle, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Brush the tops of the spanakopita with olive oil and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the spanakopita from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler and drizzle it over the spanakopita for garnish.
